meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 signal-cli 设备链接添加 Signal 频道集成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将 Signal 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.tagline_en: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Signal channels into your application

howto.what: 装好后，NanoClaw 会作为辅助设备接入你已有的 Signal 号码，通过该号码收发私聊和群聊消息。你可以在 Signal 里直接和它对话，收到的消息会进入对应会话。
howto.when: 当用户要求通过 signal-cli 添加 Signal 频道，或在 setup 流程中选择 Signal 集成时触发。

say.text: 把 Signal 接到我的手机号上
say.note: 会运行设备链接，生成二维码让你用手机扫码。
开始复制适配器、注册并安装依赖。

say.text: 配置 Signal 消息通道
say.note: 完成后你就能在 Signal 里和助手私聊或群聊。

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw links to your existing Signal number as a secondary device, using it for DMs and group chats. You can message it directly in Signal; incoming messages land in that conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a Signal channel or selects Signal integration in the setup flow.

say_en.text: Connect Signal to my phone number.
say_en.note: Runs device-link and shows a QR to scan.
After this, you can chat via Signal.
